title: New: Share to many places from your iPhone
summary: On the iPhone Share sheet, pick any number of places, actions and AIs; the note box grows to eight lines; shake or screenshot the app to report a bug or idea.

payload.title: Share to as many places as you like
payload.body: On the iPhone Share sheet, Send to, What your AI should do and Who takes it each open the same list of cards: tick as many as you want, each with the line that says what it is. Tell the people who make Trillion is one of the places, so a bug or an idea reaches them from your phone.

payload.title: A bigger note box that keeps your place
payload.body: Your note grows to eight lines, with Expand from the fifth. Leave for another app and come back: the keyboard is up and the cursor is where you left it. In the Trillion app, shake your phone or take a screenshot to report a bug or idea with a picture of the screen.

payload.title: Arrives with the next iPhone update
payload.body: The App Store update brings it to your phone. Trillion on your devices has the iPhone app and the Mac app.
